prompt: Deep in a tropical jungle, the forest floor is alive with green ferns and patterned leaves. Sunlight filters through five towering palm fronds above a moss-covered rock where a bright orchid clings. A stream winds past a fallen log draped with hanging vines and dotted with mushrooms. Nearby, a colorful parrots‐in‐flight hovers beside a cluster of orchids on a twisted branch. A jaguar slinks behind a bamboo thicket while a troop of monkeys swings on vines overhead. An ancient stone statue covered in moss sits half-buried under ferns, next to a ceramic water pot. A circle of four stacked stones rests by a small waterfall that cascades into a pebble‐lined pool. There is no plastic trash, no metal bucket, no glass bottle, no wooden hut, and no campfire.
